title: Penetration Tester
description:
We build products, experiment with ideas and turn them into real businesses. At Thea IT Solutions, every new product brings new engineering challenges, and security is something we want to get right from the beginning.

We're looking for someone who enjoys breaking things, finding vulnerabilities and understanding how systems can be exploited. You'll work directly with our engineering teams, testing products as they're being built and helping us develop a strong security-first engineering culture.

**What You'll Work On**

Perform penetration testing across web applications and APIs.

Identify vulnerabilities in authentication, authorization and access control.

Conduct mobile application security testing.

Perform vulnerability assessments and security reviews.

Use automated and manual security testing tools.

Document vulnerabilities, demonstrate their impact and recommend fixes.

Work directly with developers to verify and resolve security issues.

What We're Looking For

1–3 years of experience in application security or penetration testing.

Good understanding of OWASP Top 10.

Hands-on experience with Burp Suite and Nmap.

Understanding of web technologies, APIs and networking.

Familiarity with Linux and scripting.

Knowledge of Android security testing is a plus.

TryHackMe, Hack The Box or practical security research experience is a plus.

Someone curious, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of problems.

Pay: ₹250,000.00 - ₹450,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
